text:
This looks like scrambled egg whites (or possibly crumbled cheese) on a square plate, with a few sweet potato pieces on a side plate.

For the main plate, I estimate about 150 g of scrambled egg whites at roughly 52 kcal per 100 g, which comes to about 78 kcal. If it were cheese, the energy would be much higher. The texture is white and fluffy with some translucent pieces, which fits cooked egg whites best.

The side plate holds only a small amount of sweet potato, perhaps 30 g at about 30 kcal, and part of it is out of frame. The question asks about "everything on the plate," so I will include the main plate plus a little for the visible sweet potato.

Total: about 150 g + 30 g = 180 g, and about 78 + 30 = 108 kcal, which I round to 110.

{"kcal": 110, "mass_g": 180}
